text:
Situation: Bumetanide injection shortage was first posted by FDA on 2017-12-13 and is resolved as of 2026-10-21. Current inventory at Corvale East shows 1.4 days of 4 mL vials and 5.7 days of 10 mL vials. Corvale General holds 9 days of 4 mL vials and 13.1 days of 10 mL vials. Tablet supply exceeds 27 days at both sites.

Why (FDA record): FDA shortage history lists initial posting on 2017-12-13 involving MSN Laboratories Private Limited. Additional resolved listings include Fresenius Kabi USA LLC, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., Mullan Pharmaceutical Inc., and Sagent Pharmaceuticals. FDA inspection 927215 at Zydus Lifesciences Limited ended 2015-05-23 classified VAI, 935 days before the 2017-12-13 posting. FDA inspection 1106822 at Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. ended 2019-09-10 classified VAI, 636 days after the 2017-12-13 posting. Zydus Lifesciences Limited received a Warning Letter on 2026-06-02.

Our position: Injection inventory is critically low at Corvale East and limited at Corvale General. The shortage is resolved per FDA, and multiple suppliers are not on the current shortage list. Procurement should shift to available sources to rebuild injection stock.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders for bumetanide injection from Advagen Pharma Limited; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to place orders from Amneal Pharmaceuticals NY LLC; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to place orders from AvPAK; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer to place orders from Edenbridge Pharmaceuticals LLC; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
5. Buyer to place orders from Exelan Pharmaceuticals, Inc.; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
6. Buyer to monitor daily usage and adjust reorder points; requires Inventory Manager approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
